quote: Overrated, and the media reviews are part of the **** a game with such an enormous budget and years of development behind it, the number of technical issues, bugs, and performance problems at launch is simply unacceptable. Expectations were incredibly high, but that doesn't mean the game should be immune to criticism.What bothers me even more is the overwhelming praise from professional reviewers. How can a game with so many noticeable technical shortcomings receive perfect scores? Are we seriously supposed to believe that these issues were not significant enough to affect the overall experience?A 10/10 should represent an exceptional, polished experience, not just a recognizable franchise, massive marketing campaign, or years of hype. Reviews should evaluate the actual product players receive, not the expectations surrounding **** feels like some critics were more interested in celebrating Rockstar's reputation than objectively evaluating the game. When technical problems are overlooked and perfect scores are handed out so easily, it raises legitimate questions about the credibility and standards of professional game **** may be a massive achievement in certain areas, but that doesn't automatically make it a flawless masterpiece. It deserves criticism, just like any other game, especially at this price point.
